_comment: The Info screen (SCREEN_INFO, 9), work order 175 D. Everything it draws is placed at the HD image of its native rectangle (infogeom, through core/researchnative), and every text comes through core/modtexts by its key (infotexts), so this file carries only the markings, each also stated in the module that performs it and held by the smoke group (tools/smoke_suite/090f).

marks.hd_state: BUILT, NOT ACCEPTED. The live part of work order 175 D is parked (doc/briefs/175-parked-for-data.md).
marks.hd_state_local_navigation: HD STATE — the tabs are multi-buttons bound to a local of Info_Screen_ (current_tab) and the pages keep their state in file statics the wire never carries; HD navigates the pages itself, starting on the tab the game saved (history_btns bits 4-6), and sends only RETURN / ESC.
marks.hd_state_open_fix_32: HD STATE — the History Graph's curves and the Turn Summary need open fix 32 (doc/ext_info_screen_state.patch, NOT APPLIED); each page says so in its own moddable words and draws what it has (the legend, the metric toggles).
marks.omission_outer_frame: OMISSION — INFO.LBX 0, the frame with the tabs, drop areas and chart painted in, and the interlaced fill are not drawn; glass HUD panels stand where they are.
marks.omission_app_pictures: OMISSION — the Tech Review's application pictures (APP_PICS.LBX, info.cpp:893-896) are not extracted by this order; the picture box stays an empty panel.
marks.deviation_button_words: DEVIATION — the tabs, the tech categories, the metric toggles, BACK and RETURN are words baked into INFO.LBX; HD writes OrionLayer's words, moddable (source 'own').
marks.deviation_chart_colours: DEVIATION — the chart's bars, the legend and the texts in HUD tones, not INFO.LBX 22-25 recoloured through INFO.LBX's palette (which this order does not extract).
marks.hd_extension_wrap_and_scroll: HD EXTENSION — every text wraps to its box, a word too long for a line is broken, and a box whose lines do not fit scrolls with the mouse wheel and shows a HUD scroll bar; the original pages its lists and cuts or overruns its long texts (info.cpp:1086-1093, :1893-1906).
marks.hd_extension_moddable_texts: HD EXTENSION — every text by a stable key through core/modtexts (decision 73): a file texts/info/<key>.txt in the player's mod folder replaces it; the original's words are read from the player's own files and never copied into the tree or the template.
